% Pattern: number/ref. \newtheorem*{again}{Theorem \ref{thm:main}} restates
% thm:main under its own head, which prints the number of thm:main, so the
% restatement is 1.2 too. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want again-1 statement/theorem 1.2
% want thm-1 statement/theorem 1.1
% want thm-2 statement/theorem 1.2
\documentclass{article}
\newtheorem{thm}{Theorem}[section]
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\newtheorem*{again}{Theorem \ref{thm:main}}
\begin{again} Every fine space is compact. \end{again}
\begin{thm} Every compact space is fine. \end{thm}
\begin{thm}\label{thm:main} Every fine space is compact. \end{thm}
\end{document}
